title: Spa Franchise Opportunity
name: Tathaapi Spa, 12 Franchisees, Est'd in 2021, Jaipur HQ
description: Tathaapi wellness & spa, established in 2021, is a premium wellness brand with a team of over 150 technically qualified professionals. Our commitment to holistic wellness is reflected in the wide range of rejuvenating spa and wellness services we offer. Backed by decades of combined industry expertise, we are dedicated to delivering exceptional relaxation and wellness experiences to our clients. We are currently seeking franchise partners to operate under a FOCO (Franchise-Owned, Company-Operated) model. The company has successfully secured tenders to establish wellness and spa outlets in the departure areas of airports in Bhubaneswar, Goa, Ranchi, and Guwahati. These outlets will be fully operated by the company, while the franchise partner will own the franchise. The franchise partner is required to have a valid GST registration to be eligible for this opportunity.
